rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting something away while it is not in use.

example.english: I store the camera when I’m not using it.
example.traditional: 我唔用部相機嗰陣會收起。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jung6 bou6 soeng2 gei1 go2 zan6 wui5 sau1 hei2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on placing the stored item in a particular location.

example.english: I store my winter clothes under the bed.
example.traditional: 我將啲冬天衫擺喺床底。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 dung1 tin1 saam1 baai2 hai2 cong4 dai2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a shop where people buy things.

example.english: The clothes in this store are really nice.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 di1 saam1 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this for goods or stock held by a business, rather than for the place or a reserve.

example.english: This store is almost sold out.
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 cyun4 fo3 zau6 faai3 maai6 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the stored supply is deliberately kept as a reserve for future use.

example.english: The company kept a store of supplies for the winter.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 lau4 zo2 di1 cyu4 bei6 gwo3 dung1

rows.note: Use this for the physical storage facility, including a warehouse or stockroom.

example.english: This store is packed with the company's goods.
example.traditional: 呢間倉庫擺滿晒公司啲貨。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 cong1 fu3 baai2 mun5 saai3 gung1 si1 di1 fo3
